summary: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 5,385,646 common shares and 4,574,514 pre-funded warrants at $2.51 per share ($2.509 per pre-funded warrant), raising approximately $24.995 million. The pre-funded warrants have an exercise price of $0.001 and are exercisable immediately until fully exercised; placement agent warrants for 298,805 shares are also included. Titan Partners Group LLC serves as sole placement agent. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. Proceeds will go to general corporate purposes. No tender, merger, or transformative event is involved.
